description.value: SureStay by Best Western is a mid-range hotel on Capilano Road in North Vancouver, situated roughly 22 miles from Vancouver International Airport and 16 miles from downtown Vancouver. It offers standard rooms and suites under the Best Western loyalty umbrella, with complimentary breakfast and free high-speed internet included. Its location near the base of Capilano makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the North Shore or using the area as a staging point before or after crossing into Vancouver.
